items.q: Ethene reacts with bromine water. What type of reaction is this?
items.qAf: Eteen reageer met broomwater. Watter soort reaksie is dit?
items.explain: The C=C double bond is broken and two Br atoms are added across it.
items.explainAf: Die C=C-dubbelbinding breek en twee Br-atome word oor dit gevoeg.

items.q: Methane reacts with chlorine in sunlight, replacing an H atom with Cl. What type of reaction is this?
items.qAf: Metaan reageer met chloor in sonlig en vervang ’n H-atoom met Cl. Watter soort reaksie is dit?
items.explain: An atom in the alkane is replaced by another atom, which is substitution.
items.explainAf: ’n Atoom in die alkaan word deur ’n ander atoom vervang, wat substitusie is.

items.q: Ethanol is heated with concentrated sulfuric acid to form ethene. What type of reaction is this?
items.qAf: Etanol word met gekonsentreerde swaelsuur verhit om eteen te vorm. Watter soort reaksie is dit?
items.explain: Water is removed from ethanol to form a C=C double bond, which is an elimination (dehydration) reaction.
items.explainAf: Water word uit etanol verwyder om ’n C=C-dubbelbinding te vorm, wat ’n eliminasie- (dehidrasie-) reaksie is.

items.explain: Thermal or catalytic cracking produces smaller alkanes and alkenes.
items.explainAf: Termiese of katalitiese kraking lewer kleiner alkane en alkene.

items.q: Decane (C₁₀H₂₂) cracks to form octane (C₈H₁₈) and one other product. What is the formula of the other product?
items.qAf: Dekaan (C₁₀H₂₂) kraak om oktaan (C₈H₁₈) en een ander produk te vorm. Wat is die formule van die ander produk?
items.explain: Atoms must balance: C₁₀H₂₂ → C₈H₁₈ + C₂H₄.
items.explainAf: Atome moet balanseer: C₁₀H₂₂ → C₈H₁₈ + C₂H₄.

items.q: Ethanoic acid reacts with propan-1-ol to form an ester. What other product is formed?
items.qAf: Etanoësuur reageer met propan-1-ol om ’n ester te vorm. Watter ander produk word gevorm?
items.explain: Esterification is a condensation reaction: a carboxylic acid and an alcohol form an ester and water.
items.explainAf: Esterifikasie is ’n kondensasiereaksie: ’n karboksielsuur en ’n alkohol vorm ’n ester en water.
